explanation: At each offset, try every next substring and test it for palindromicity. Recurse only on palindromic pieces and copy each complete partition into the output, preserving the original character order.
timeComplexity: O(n^2 2^n) safe worst-case upper bound including substring copying and palindrome checks.
spaceComplexity: O(n) current partition and recursion space, plus O(n 2^n) worst-case output.
